QuestInfo.name: Rina's Worries
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1010100##k in #b#m100000000# seems to be worried about something. Talk to #p1010100#.
QuestInfo.1: #p1010100# says that she wants to make some Blue Mushroom porridge for #p1012101# who is sick but that they are difficult to get because the #o2220100#s have become so violent. You tell her that you will get them for her but #p1010100# says not to because it is so dangerous...

0.0: Huh? Am I worried about something? Well, the truth is that #p1012101#'s health has been getting worse these days so I want to make her some Blue Mushroom Porridge but it's so difficult to find any #t4000009#s.\r\n#L0##b Are #o2220100#s rare?#l\n#k
0.1: No, that's not true, because a lot of them live in the Blue Mushroom Forest. The #o2220100#s have become so violent these days, it's pretty difficult to collect them. I want to hurry up and feed #p1012101# some Blue Mushroom porridge... Mmmm. \r\n#L0##bShould I get the #t4000009#s?#l\n#k
0.2: You? No way. What are you thinking? Facing #o2220100# is no picnic. And #o1210102# is on a different level from the #o2220100#. Just keep away from them! Okay?\r\n

yes.0: Okay... Don't do anything dangerous. I'll just ask another adventurer who happens to pass this way.
yes.1: Oh and um... Please don't take this the wrong way but... Why are you walking around with a lizard? A pet? I guess he is kind of cute but...you have a pretty peculiar taste...

no.0: Don't even think about it! Don't you dare go there! Never!

1.0: Master, she is in trouble! We can help her!\r\n#L0##bNot this time. She says it's dangerous.#l\n#k
1.1: That's exactly why we should step in! We can't call ourselves a hero if we keep avoiding anything dangerous. Silly master!\r\n

npc.0: You can't do it so don't even think about going near the #o2220100#s! I'm not kidding! And this isn't one of those quests where you're supposed to do the opposite!
